classification.difficultyReason: Identify opposite pairs and find acute angles, supported by the first-part scaffold.

content.prompt: Find the value of the unknown in these triangles, correct to 1 decimal place.

spec.description: Upright left edge, slightly rising top edge, and diagonal from lower-left to upper-right. Top side 5 m; diagonal 8 m. Interior 100° at upper-left and θ at lower-left, both with arcs.
spec.mathematics: sin θ / 5 = sin 100° / 8. Dark-blue edges #253F8E; black labels and angle marks. No vertex names printed.

spec.description: Inverted triangle with horizontal upper side 10 cm and lower vertex toward the right. Left sloping side 12 cm. Interior 70° at upper-right and θ at the lower vertex, with arcs.
spec.mathematics: sin θ / 10 = sin 70° / 12. Dark-blue edges #253F8E; black labels and angle marks. No vertex names printed.

spec.description: Horizontal lower side 10 m, long rising side 18 m from lower-left to high upper-right. Interior 120° at lower-right and θ at the upper tip, both with arcs.
spec.mathematics: sin θ / 10 = sin 120° / 18. Dark-blue edges #253F8E; black labels and angle marks. Source is not to scale; no notice or vertex names printed.
